name: MoYu WeiLong WR M MagLev 3x3
description: The WeiLong WR M MagLev is the latest version in the famous WeiLong line. This 3x3 features purple internals, magnetic adjustment, tension and compression adjustment, and a maglev system in place of traditional springs. Maglev technology utilizes opposing magnets (magnetic levitation) to replicate spring force, this reduces friction and completely eliminates spring noise.
